A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
trichloroethylene and chloral hydrate are both potent sedatives and hypnotics.

the effects of ethanol are mediated via GABAA receptors and the effect is not dependent on the presence of the GABAB receptor antagonist, CGP 55845.
